title: Muir Woods and Sausalito Small-Group Tour
description: Half-day small-group tour from San Francisco to Muir Woods National Monument and Sausalito, including scenic views and free time to explore.

title: Santa Barbara Vineyard to Table Taste Tour by E-Bike
description: Ride through the towns and vineyards of the Santa Ynez Valley wine region on this e-bike tour with transport from Santa Barbara. With a guide, you'll pedal a Rad Power E-bike to wineries, a lavendar farm, the town of Solvang, and other spots for wine and olive-oil tastings and lunch. A bike tour allows you to enjoy better views of the scenery than from inside a car.

title: Mountain Sunrise Hike and Meditation in Palm Springs
description: Start your Palm Springs morning on a guided pre-dawn hike that climbs toward sunrise viewpoints above the Coachella Valley. Your guide sets a steady pace along the South Lykken Trail corridor and pauses for interpretation on local geology, desert ecosystems, and canyon terrain. At a scenic rest point, the experience shifts into a grounding meditation session designed to help you reset before the day heats up. This small-group outing balances moderate physical effort with reflective time in nature, making it a strong fit for travelers who want an active, meaningful desert experience.

title: Grand Canyon West 6-in-1 Tour with Helicopter and Landing
description: Depart Las Vegas for a full-day West Rim adventure with a small-group guide, scenic desert drive, and timed stops at Hoover Dam and a Joshua tree forest. At Grand Canyon West you can take in Eagle Point and Guano Point viewpoints, then elevate the day with an optional helicopter descent and landing near the Colorado River before returning to Las Vegas.

title: Zion and Bryce Canyon Small Group Tour from Las Vegas
description: Travel from Las Vegas on a full-day guided tour to two iconic Utah parks. Explore Bryce Canyon's amphitheater viewpoints and continue to Zion National Park for dramatic canyon scenery, interpretive guidance, and photo stops before returning to Las Vegas the same day.

title: Red Rock Canyon Electric Bike Tour
description: Explore the Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area on a guided electric bike tour from Las Vegas. Ride portions of the scenic loop with support from your guide while stopping at overlooks to learn about Mojave Desert geology, wildlife, and conservation.

title: Valley Of Fire Best Offroad Adventure
description: Explore rugged desert terrain on an off-road-focused Valley of Fire adventure from Las Vegas. This experience emphasizes geological textures, remote access, and exploratory pacing with key stops at landmark formations such as Elephant Rock, Rainbow Vista, and petroglyph viewing areas when available.

title: Red Rock Canyon with Rocky Gap 4x4 Adventure
description: Travel from Las Vegas into Red Rock Canyon and continue into the Rocky Gap backcountry for a route that blends scenic interpretation with technical 4x4 terrain. The itinerary emphasizes key sandstone viewpoints, geology context, and the rougher Rocky Gap section that distinguishes this trip from standard scenic-drive alternatives.

title: Antelope Canyon Horseshoe Bend Day Tour from Las Vegas
description: Leave Las Vegas before sunrise for a full-day desert loop that pairs two signature Southwest sights in one guided outing. After a scenic drive toward Page, stretch your legs on the hike to Horseshoe Bend, then continue to Antelope Canyon for a Navajo-led walk through sculpted sandstone corridors with dedicated photo stops. Round-trip transport, canyon admission, and lunch are handled so you can focus on the landscapes instead of logistics.

title: Emerald Cave Kayaking Tour
description: Leave the Strip behind for a guided paddle through one of the Colorado River’s calmest and most scenic stretches. After an optional hotel pickup in Las Vegas, you’ll launch at Willow Beach Marina, review safety basics, and kayak in a small group toward Emerald Cave. The route is beginner-friendly, with time to pause for photos, wildlife spotting, and a snack break on the shoreline. Your guide shares local context while keeping the pace comfortable for mixed experience levels. Choose hotel transport or self-drive, then return after a half-day on the water with memorable canyon views and cave reflections.

title: Off Road Las Vegas Tour
description: Leave pavement behind on a guided off-road route in the Las Vegas desert with pre-ride orientation, terrain briefings, and staged scenic stops. This experience focuses on technical trail variety including sandy washes, rocky ledges, and open desert sections while maintaining a guide-led pace appropriate for mixed experience levels.

title: Brooklyn Bridge Waterfront Guided Bike Tour
description: Pedal from Lower Manhattan into Brooklyn with a local guide on a route that links riverfront parks, historic bridge crossings, and neighborhood viewpoints. This small-group ride combines skyline photo stops, local history, and a manageable pace suitable for travelers who want an active city overview without planning the route themselves.

title: Classic Manhattan Electric Bike Tour
description: Ride through Manhattan with a local guide on an electric bike route built for efficient sightseeing and neighborhood context. This experience blends major skyline viewpoints with quieter side streets so you can cover more ground in about half a day without an all-day effort.

title: New York in One Day Guided Sightseeing Tour
description: Make the most of your time in New York City by taking a tour that includes transportation. Take a bus ride past the 9/11 Memorial, Central Park, Rockefeller Center, and more. Then hop aboard the Staten Island Ferry to see the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island.

title: Niagara Falls in One Day from New York City
description: Visit Niagara Falls on a full-day guided trip from New York City with roundtrip transportation, scenic viewpoints, and free time to explore one of North America's most iconic natural attractions.

title: Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island Guided Tour
description: Explore two of New York Harbor's most important landmarks with a guided tour that includes ferry access, historical context, and time to discover Liberty Island and Ellis Island.

title: Washington D.C. Tour from New York
description: Take a full-day guided tour from New York to Washington, D.C. to see major landmarks including the White House area, Capitol Hill, and key memorials, with roundtrip transportation included.

title: Philadelphia and Amish Country Day Trip from New York
description: Travel from New York City to Philadelphia and Pennsylvania Amish Country on a guided day trip that combines history, culture, and small-town scenery.

title: Manhattan Sky Tour: New York Helicopter Flight
description: Take to the air for a compact helicopter sightseeing flight above Manhattan and New York Harbor. This route is designed for travelers who want a high-impact skyline experience in a short window, with aerial views of headline landmarks and live pilot commentary that helps orient first-time and repeat visitors alike.

title: Manhattan Adventure Sightseeing Boat Tour - from Chelsea Piers
description: Capture New York City’s landmarks from the water on this custom Manhattan sightseeing tour designed for photographers and tourists, departing from Midtown. Sail past famous sights such as the Statue of Liberty, the Brooklyn Bridge, and the Manhattan skyline, with plenty of stops for perfect photo opportunities. Enjoy expert narration from the captain as you explore the Hudson River and New York Harbor from unique vantage points.

title: New York City Sunset or Daytime Sightseeing Cruise
description: Set sail on a 1950s-style yacht for an unforgettable 90-minute sightseeing cruise around New York Harbor. Enjoy stunning sunset views of Manhattan’s skyline, the Statue of Liberty, and other iconic landmarks. Relax on the open bow or covered outdoor deck while sipping a complimentary beverage and nibbling on light hors d'oeuvres. Capture breathtaking photos of New York's most famous landmarks and enjoy this scenic adventure with friends and family.

title: Half-Day Bus Tour of NYC Top Highlights
description: This tour is a great pick for time-tight travelers looking to check off some of New York’s best bits in half a day. Set off in a climate-controlled luxury bus and listen to stories about local landmarks from your guide. Photo stops along the route showcase views of top sights, including the Brooklyn Bridge and Rockefeller Center—all with plenty of time to capture memorable shots.

title: New York City Private Walking Tour with a Local
description: You could explore Manhattan on your own—but a guided walking tour makes finding (and learning about) the sights so much easier. On this flexible tour, choose a duration and itinerary that work best for your schedule, and explore with just your private guide for company. Look forward to experiencing the energy of Times Square, relaxing in Bryant Park, exploring media history at Rockefeller Center, and much more.

title: NYC Bustronome Gourmet Sightseeing Lunch Panoramic Bus
description: Savor a gourmet multi-course menu aboard a glass-roofed double-decker bus while taking in breathtaking views of New York’s most iconic landmarks. A unique blend of fine dining and sightseeing.
